Box2Robot Skills 1.0.0

- Initial release providing a complete reference for Box2Robot control and orchestration via CLI and HTTP API.
- Covers device authentication, command line usage, action definitions (79 actions), and typical scene workflows.
- Maps natural language instructions to underlying commands for LLM agents.
- Includes comprehensive pre-check rules for action execution and error handling.
- Outlines available LLM/API tools for chat-based robotic control.
- Provides HTTP API example usage and endpoints for programmatic access.
